text:
maya: FYI starting a phased enable for novaX-7b v2 tomorrow 2025-07-21 18:00 UTC. scope=beta -> staged-public.
sam: Can you post the ramp plan and hard gates?
maya: Ramp plan: 3% -> 15% -> 50% -> 100%; each stage has a 20m bake. warmup cache = 12m per shard.
chen: Propose hard rollback gates: error-rate +1.5% sustained (5m) OR p95 latency > 750ms (10m) OR eval-embed cosine drop > .06. Also watch 429s separately.
elena: Fallback ordering? we need a cost-conscious ladder for mobile callers.
maya: Fallback ladder: novaX-7b-v2 (FP16) -> novaX-7b-quant-lite -> arc-11b-compat -> peg-6b-legacy. Note: prefer same-arch quant when available.
priya: Telemetry checklist: model.route.latency.p50/p95, model.errors.429, token.cost.delta, kvcache.hitrate. Alert if kvcache.hitrate < 72% in first 30m.
maya: Uploaded eval bundle s3://redwood-release/novaX/evset_v2_20250721.json
sam: Ensure deploybot flag --no-variant-escalation for first two stages. Also pin policy so beta tenants get v2 explicitly.
maya: done: pin_policy=beta_only and deploybot arg applied.
deploy-bot: Scheduled: catalog.enable(model=novaX-7b-v2, scope=beta, ramp=3->15->50->100, start=2025-07-21T18:00:00Z). Reaction: :robot_face:
chen: Add a 429 guard: hold rollout if 429 rate > 1% for 5m.
maya: Adding. Also manual holdpoint after stage2 for ops ack.
elena: Ops ack conditions: p95 < 750ms, 5xx+429 < 1.5%, kvcache.hitrate >= 72%.
priya: Release note blurb: "novaX-7b v2 (FP16): improved long-context coherence and prompt handling. Beta rollout 2025-07-21. Monitor telemetry in Console."
sam: Rollback mechanism? traffic swap or immediate disable?
maya: Default: traffic-swap back to novaX-7b-v1 at stage cutoff. If we detect bad weights or corrupt artifacts -> catalog.disable immediate.
deploy-bot: Action: enabling at 3% now. cmd=enable model=novaX-7b-v2 scope=beta target=3% ts=6160001240
chen: Initial p50 bump only. no errors. token cost +2% at 3%.
maya: proceeding to stage1 bake. will post at stage transitions.
deploy-bot: Next stage scheduled in 18m. To abort: `deploy-bot abort 6160001234`.
elena: If rollback, tag #eng-sre and #prod-eng in this thread. Keep rollback short and record the trigger.
priya: Checklist in release doc: snapshot bundle, run eval, notify support, snapshot infra metrics. Link: https://console.redwood/release/novaX/6160001234
sam: Noted. I'll be standing by for ops ack at stage2.
deploy-bot: Stage2 executed: scaled to 15% at ts=6160001275. cmd=scale model=novaX-7b-v2 target=15%
chen: Metrics at 15%: p95 flat, errors 0.4%, 429=0.3%, kvcache.hitrate=78%. Holding for ops ack.
maya: Looks good. ops ack pending but likely green.
sam: Ops acked via console. proceed to 50% after bake.
deploy-bot: Bake complete. Next ramp in 20m.
maya: If anything breaches gates we swap traffic to v1 and open rollback runbook.
